features: indoor pan/tilt AI Wi-Fi camera, 2K QHD 4MP (2688x1520), HDR, 360 degree pan / 149 degree tilt
1/2.9" starlight sensor, 4.3 mm F1.6 lens, 30 fps, 3D DNR + WDR
IR night vision 9 m: 1 x 850 nm + 2 x 940 nm invisible IR LEDs (toggleable)
smart motion tracking up to 120 degree/s; person, line-crossing, tamper, baby-cry, pet, glass-breaking detection
physical privacy shield (lens conceal), two-way audio with noise cancellation, 98 dB siren
microSD up to 512 GB or Tapo Care cloud; RTSP/ONVIF, Apple HomeKit, Alexa, Google Assistant

frigate.notes: Enable the camera account/ONVIF in the Tapo app. Streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Enable ONVIF in Tapo app.
